Reports unchanged blocking fees: 0.10 EUR/min from minute 241 on WSW AC/DC during 08:00-18:00, and from minute 46 at DC >50 kW regardless of time; also distinguishes WSW-own, roaming and card pricing.

cpos.conclusion: Exact 2026 WSW own-network card tariffs are known and ad-hoc fast-charger pricing is partly evidenced, but the evidence does not establish a complete direct/ad-hoc matrix for all AC and DC EVSEs. Do not substitute the WSW eMobil subscriber/card tariff as universal ad-hoc pricing.
